propositions: The complexity-baseline lock script runs four times per Verified change—once in each OS/Python matrix cell (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.12)—consuming approximately 206 runner-seconds total (52s+54s+55s+45s).
The lock is a commit-level policy with no OS/Python-dependent behavior; a single execution in the lint job preserves policy coverage and fail-closed semantics.

Moving the unchanged lock invocation from jobs.test to jobs.lint eliminates four duplicate check-outs and merge-base fetches, estimated to save ~154 runner-seconds per Verify run without removing jobs, runners, or coverage.
After the move, the complexity-baseline lock must execute exactly once, blocking in the lint job, and must be absent from the test matrix.
A workflow unit oracle must fail on the current four-matrix-invocation placement and on any future duplicate placement, and return to RED if the matrix invocation is reintroduced.
